etsy.title: Rally Sticker Sheet, 6 Co-Driver Pace Notes Kiss-Cut Stickers, Tulip Roadbook, Motorsport Gift for Rally Fan
etsy.description:
A sticker sheet of six rally stickers for co-drivers and rally fans: TULIP (not the flower), I said left, left right oops, hairpin square flat, gravel snow tarmac, and square left don't cut.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One kiss-cut sticker sheet, 5.83 × 8.27 in (A5), shipped directly to you
• 6 stickers, each about 2.4 in: Tulip, I Said Left, Left Right Oops, Hairpin Square Flat, Gravel Snow Tarmac, Square Left Don't Cut
• Each sticker is cut individually, so you can peel them off one at a time
• For indoor use. Not waterproof

HOW TO USE
• Laptops, water bottles kept out of the dishwasher, planners, journals, notebooks and phone cases
• A ready-made gift for a rally driver, co-driver, WRC fan or car enthusiast, or a stocking stuffer that costs less than six separate stickers

Printed on demand and shipped from the nearest Printify print partner.
